headline: Citizens in Islamabad are unable to find influenza vaccines this winter, and Drap CEO Dr Obaidullah Malik said the Chinese Sinovac vaccine would be made available by Nov 15, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Vaxigrip aur Influvac is saal market mein nahi milengi.

caption:
Sardiyon se pehle flu vaccine market se ghayab!
Dawn ke mutabiq Islamabad mein shehri flu vaccine dhoond rahe hain magar nahi mil rahi. Drap CEO Dr Obaidullah Malik ne kaha ke Chinese vaccine Sinovac 15 November tak dastiyab kar di jayegi, jabke health ministry ke ek afsar ke mutabiq Vaxigrip aur Influvac is saal consumers ko nahi milengi.
Kya aap ko flu vaccine mil saki? Comment mein batayein 👇
